implementation.invocation: Use the host shell execution tool with argument-safe quoting; parse JSON even for exit 2. Preserve the CLI data envelope; map operation_id to task_id when normalizing. No paid actions.
Use the orders commands documented by tradecli --help. Execute only authorized simulated orders.

Validate and prepare a plan. For market orders use batches validate-market and batches prepare-market. After the user confirms account, directions, codes and quantities, execute batches run-simulated with --yes, batch ID and digest. Inspect status and ledger.
After visual holdings review, run batches plan-market with the private strategy file and review_path. Render every returned row as the confirmation table.

After explicit confirmation of account and full table, prepare and run the matching simulated or real market-order batch exactly once. Inspect status and current-day ledger. Market form and a canceled simulated confirmation have been inspected on Windows; successful real-account acceptance remains untested.
Use Codex view_image for the returned local image_path, then the host filesystem tool to write a new private JSON review. Validate through tradecli positions review.
